# Radio and 911 Dispatch
## Radio - Law enforcement talk on the [bold]CMB[/bold] channel with [color=#a4885c]:3[/color], and to the rest of the colony on [bold]Colony[/bold] with [color=#a4885c]:o[/color]. - The CMB channel also carries criminal record updates and 911 calls, so keep an ear on it. - Your pouch has a handheld radio as a backup. - See the [textlink="Communications Guide" link="AU14Comms"] for more on radios.
## 911 Dispatch Colonists can call 911 from any phone: a rotary phone, a payphone or a mobile phone. - The caller picks [bold]Fire/Medical[/bold] or [bold]Law Enforcement[/bold]. Dispatch then asks where the emergency is and what happened. - The call comes through as a report on both the [bold]CMB[/bold] and [bold]Colony Medical[/bold] channels, with the caller's name, the phone used, the location and the details. - Each phone can only call 911 once every 2 minutes.
## Answering a Call - Acknowledge the call on the radio so your colleagues know it's covered. - Head to the location given, and bring medical if the call needs it. - If the caller gave a phone, you can call them back for more detail.
